The room is located in a guest house with a common kitchen you can use. The wifi is good, and the room is clean. The guest house is quiet. The area in general in very quiet. There are grocery stores just across the street, so it s very conveniently located. The women working at the guest house are very helpful and very pleasant. I would definitely stay here again if I come back to Bulawayo.
